 Additional Standing Counsel

 01. 1.

entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: This matter is taken up through hybrid mode.

2. Grievance of the Petitioner, in this writ petition, is with regard to payment of compensation in terms of judgment dated 5th August, 2025 passed by learned Civil Judge (Sr. Division), Nuapada in LAR No.130 of 2010 in a reference under Section 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (for brevity,
'the Act').
3.

Mr. Behera, learned counsel for the Petitioner submits that although compensation amount has been enhanced by learned Civil Judge (Senior Division), Nuapada in a reference under Section 18 of the Act but the Petitioner has not yet been paid the same.

It is submitted that the matter is pending with the Director (R&R)-cum- Ex-Officio Special Secretary, Water Resources Department,
Government of Odisha for sanction.
3. Mr. Mishra, learned Additional Standing Counsel prays for an adjournment to take instruction in that regard.

4. Put up this matter on 10th April, 2026. Instruction, if any shall be obtained by Mr. Mishra,
learned Additional Standing Counsel in the meantime.
(K.R. Mohapatra) Judge (S.K. Mishra) Judge Himansu Signed by: HIMANSU SEKHAR DASH Designation: Personal Assistant Reason: Authentication
